why_agent_cannot: enter an email and click the confirmation link
what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Canborsa Points Program Go to the Canborsa app page , which is where the Start Earning button on the homepage leads.
2 Step 2 : Sign in or create an account Use the sign-in page and continue with Google, X, a wallet, a passkey or an email address.

3 Step 3 : Fund your account if you want to trade Trading needs a funded balance, which you add on one of the supported networks. The Points Program section on the homepage is titled around trading and swapping.
4 Step 4 : Complete quests and use multipliers Finish the tasks listed as quests to earn points, and use the multipliers Canborsa offers to boost what you earn.
5 Step 5 : Share your referral link Open the referrals page to find your own link; Canborsa says invited users' activity earns you rewards.
